name: Elizabeth Oshiro
source:
Elizabeth Oshiro, known as one of the top students in the academy (if not the best), has been a classmate of Yama Ishimoto. She is mostly seen with a bunch of "groupies", as Yama calls them with Natsuki Tanaka, a friend of hers.

[spoiler]She has little to no talent for music, so she self teaches herself the piano, simply due to being mocked about it. She is also a great sharpshooter, and is an only daughter of a policeman.[/spoiler]
